{{Otheruses|squall}}
An '''asteroid squall''' was a kind of astrogeographical accident that was supposed to be charted, but not always was.

Captain [[Mirchidi NeMall]]'s ship, [[NeHimmep (freighter)|''NeHimmep'']], once crashed with an asteroid squall. The ship was severely damaged and her [[rinzefruit]] cargo was lost; NeMall's insurance covered only the ship's repairs.
